author: NanoBarashed
quote: A failed game, plagued by endless problems. Where did those 13 years go, and where did the 2 billion dollars vanish to? There are constant frame-rate issues, and—to top it off—blatant pornography and nudity, with no way to disable or skip these offensive, explicit scenes. I also recently discovered that it’s impossible to kill transgender characters; the game is filled with homosexual themes and repulsive feminist ideology. Is this supposed to be a game about gangs? It’s more like a romance game! I hope you all fail in your own lives. Also, note that the online mode hasn’t even been released yet—so how did it get a perfect score? It’s clear now: everything you did was just bribery, because this game pushes every single one of these agendas.
